config_dir.ask: Folder holding your Micro-Manager hardware configuration files (.cfg)
config_dir.help: Usually the Micro-Manager install folder. The next question lists the .cfg files found there.

config_file.ask: Hardware configuration to load ('demo' for the built-in demo configuration with no hardware)
config_file.help: The .cfg the lab built with Micro-Manager's Hardware Configuration Wizard. It must define a camera, an XY stage, a focus stage and the channel config group.

data_dir.ask: Folder where images are saved as TIFF

channel_group.ask: Name of the config group that holds the channel presets
